releases.body:
## What's new

- Removed the per-model RPM/TPM rate-limit summary windows and the account-level "all models" rate-limit summary from the usage report.
- The plan-credits wallet window (shown when no plan tier is configured, or when the balance exceeds the tier) now stays visible at a 0 balance instead of disappearing; negative values clamp to 0.
- The estimated plan-credits window now explicitly reports the used percentage (rounded to two decimals) together with a stable monthly reset (first day of next month, 00:00 UTC) and a 30-day span, enabling magpie's Pace / Runs out projections.
- The API balance and plan-credits wallet windows are marked aside: no new 100% flat-line data points are recorded for them; the card still shows the remaining balance as text.
- README: new "Multiple machines" section; Usage and Charts documentation updated, including routing limitations.

## Notes for users upgrading from 0.2.0

- Old 100% flat lines for Plan credits / API balance may remain on the chart card — existing history is not cleared (without new data points, the host's 45-day cleanup never triggers).
- Known limitation: without a DIEM balance, all the remaining usage windows are aside, so magpie treats the account's usage as unknown — provider pool caps do not apply, a capped account is held under `--careful on`, and same-currency multi-account ordering by balance is unavailable. Single-account setups without caps are unaffected (see README).

## What's new

- Per-currency usage windows in magpie's panel: plan credits (subscription), API balance (recharged USD) and daily DIEM each get their own wallet window, ordered by Venice's charge order, with the DIEM epoch reset time on the DIEM window.
- Optional plan-credit progress estimate: set your plan tier once via `magpie plugin options` (`{"plan":"pro"|"plus"|"max"}`) and the plan-credits window becomes an estimate with a used percentage (official monthly allowances: Pro 1 / Plus 75 / Max 225 credits).
- Billing order documented in the README: Venice charges DIEM, then earned credits, then bundled credits, then USD, automatically continuing on USD when bundled credits run out — no switch needed.
- Rate-limit summary windows and error handling are unchanged.

## Breaking

- The top-level `balance` string in the usage report is removed in favor of the per-currency wallet windows (affects `magpie quota --json` readers).

Initial release of opencode-venice-auth — a magpie / OpenCode v1 provider plugin for Venice.ai.

- Sign in with a Venice API key (authorize validates via /api_keys/rate_limits)
- Dynamic text-model list from GET /models?type=text (offline/beta/deprecated/e2ee/non-tool-call filtered; nested OpenCode Model shape)
- Chat via OpenAI-compatible endpoint, streaming passthrough
- Usage display: balances, key expiry, per-type rate-limit summaries
- CI: bun test + tsc + pluvy gate; release publishing via npm staged publishing (maintainer approves with 2FA)
